• *[Product Launch]* <https://example.com/notion-ai-notes|Notion rolls out AI-powered meeting notes for Business plans>
Notion launched a new AI feature that automatically generates meeting notes and action items inside docs, available first to Business and Enterprise customers.

• *[Marketing]* <https://example.com/notion-campaign|Notion launches global brand campaign 'Connected Workspace'>
Notion kicked off a new global ad campaign positioning itself as the connected workspace for modern teams, its first major marketing push in two years.

• *[Funding]* <https://example.com/linear-funding|Linear raises new growth round to expand enterprise roadmap>
Linear closed a new funding round aimed at expanding its enterprise feature set and growing its international go-to-market team.

• *[Product Launch]* <https://example.com/linear-triage|Linear ships customer requests triage view>
Linear released a new triage view that helps product teams turn incoming customer feedback into prioritized backlog items faster.

• *[Hiring/Leadership]* <https://example.com/asana-vp|Asana appoints new VP of Product to lead AI initiatives>
Asana named a new VP of Product tasked with accelerating its AI-assisted work management features, signaling a stronger push into AI this year.

• *[Partnership]* <https://example.com/clickup-zoom|ClickUp partners with Zoom for native meeting integration>
ClickUp announced a native Zoom integration letting users start and log meetings directly from tasks without switching apps.
